body: BUG-1195 fix is up: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/1902 (drive mode; needs your independent review + merge). Root cause verified: the envelope guard's lookup used the per-user queue_list while the plan-builder uses queue_list_with_role_fallback, so a review story filed by a sibling session under joe was invisible to the drain's role:implementer lookup; read errors were also collapsed to 'no story'. Storage-backed regression test reproduces the BUG-1193 shape. Once merged, please rebuild the drain binary before the next batch.
